items.context: @Daisy5Aurora (DaisyAurora, 1.782 seguidores), en inglés, con imagen del gráfico: "$BTC has now dropped completely BELOW the rainbow chart. The model has collapsed." Publicado hace ~39 min: 119 likes, 1 respuesta, 3 guardados, 460 vistas. Tema arcoíris de riesgo (tono optimista).
items.suggested_text:
Worth separating two things: price leaving the bands, and the idea behind them breaking. The Rainbow Chart was never a law. It's a log curve with color bands fitted to past cycles, a map of sentiment rather than a forecast with a guarantee, so a print outside the bands is a reason to refit them, not proof the long-term trend is gone.

What it was built to show still stands: 14 years, four halvings, from about $12 to more than $100,000, and every bear market along the way felt like "the model has collapsed" while it was happening.

Models get revised all the time. The question that tends to age better is whether the thing they were trying to measure ever stopped growing.
